comment: The completeness contract for the release checklist's 'read these' section (obj-mtg8urof-p). Every PR merged to main since the tag named in `since` must appear in exactly one of `doors` or `dismissed`; scripts/release-prepare.mjs fails loud on any merged PR it cannot classify, any door here that is not merged in range, and any label/manifest disagreement. `doors` is authoritative — sourced from the ruler's helm log (obj-mtg8urof-p thread, Lea msg 596830be, 2026-08-30), AMENDED by the discoverer's tripwire and ruled in msg be027fce: #206/#208/#228 were morning doors the afternoon-weighted helm grep missed — the mechanism working as designed. From 0.9.0 on: every PR that lands a surfaced door gets the `door` label at surfacing time AND a row here in the same PR.
